description: Reads a Segment and outputs its two endpoints (x1,y1 / x2,y2), midpoint (x,y), angle and length.
instructions: Wire a Segment source into the input; this publishes the segment's two ENDPOINTS `val-x1`/`val-y1` and `val-x2`/`val-y2`, its MIDPOINT `val-x`/`val-y`, plus `val-angle` (degrees) and `val-length` (metres) — all in metres. Wire the midpoint into a Point to place an object on the segment, or the endpoints / angle to build and orient it along the wall (e.g. a door). It has no geometry of its own.
